QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults to off (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). - `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` defaults to off (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:2196`).

WHY: The answer names both macros as the gates for threading/mutex code, stating that the mutexes exist only when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is enabled and that the pthread spawn site is gated by `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD`.
